Hi Alice — great to hear procurement is engaged. Short answers up front, details below.

- Card on file: supported for self-serve and smaller commitments.
- Monthly invoice: supported for enterprise accounts once Finance completes the credit setup (MSA + W-9 + PO where required).
- Net terms: standard is Net 30. We can consider Net 45 on an exception basis; Net 60 is rare and would need underwriting.
- Fees: Net 45 typically carries a small admin surcharge (1.5%–2.0%) depending on spend profile; Net 30 is fee-free.
- Consolidated invoicing: yes — we can consolidate across US business units onto a single invoice/PO if you provide the entity mapping and PO references.

What Finance needs from your side to enable monthly invoicing:
1) Signed MSA (we have a DocuSign link we can send).
2) Completed credit application (one-page form).
3) Copy of company W-9 (or equivalent tax form).
4) Billing contact + remittance instructions (ACH details preferred).

I attached a sample invoice PDF and a short note that explains the line items (tokens, embeddings, overages). In terms of discounts: committed monthly spend qualifies for a volume discount and can also affect allowable Net terms; if you expect >= $50k/mo committed spend, we can discuss a tailored cadence.

Would you prefer a quick 20-minute call with Finance to walk procurement through the setup? If so, I can loop in our billing lead (Marissa).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop

Redwood Inference

Hi Alice / Lauren — looping in Finance Ops (Marissa) to help with specifics. A couple of practical notes from Finance Ops:

- Net terms: Net 30 is standard. We can approve Net 45 for established partners; Net 60 requires CFO approval and a short underwriting window. For Net45 there is typically a 2% administrative fee (applied to the invoice total) unless the account hits a committed-spend threshold.
- Discounts: volume discounts are applied on the committed tokens/spend line in the SOW; they reduce the recurring invoice amount and therefore the amount subject to any admin fee.
- Consolidated invoice: we can do a single invoice for multiple bill-to entities if they share a parent PO and you provide legal entity mapping (company tax IDs). This sometimes requires that the PO line items reference each sub-entity in your ERP.
- International / tax: for US invoices we invoice without VAT; Sales tax handling depends on the ship-to state and your reseller status.

I attached a small excerpt of the rate card that shows the discount bands and an example of a consolidated invoice layout. Marissa, can you confirm list of docs we send to procurement and estimated timeline once we receive them?

Thanks,
